estimated_entrance_mappings.name: Unmeasured entrance-group sensitivity before station 401998
estimated_entrance_mappings.basis: Calibration-only group hypothesis: 401996 to 401998 net +235 veh/h, while measured Mathilda exit minus entrance is about -462 veh/h. Other unmeasured entries and exits remain unresolved; 700 is not a count for this ramp.

estimated_entrance_mappings.name: Unmeasured SR-85-area entrance-group sensitivity before station 401507
estimated_entrance_mappings.basis: Calibration-only group hypothesis: the observed 401948 to 401507 net increase is about 2047 veh/h across five weekdays. The 401948 lane mismatch and unmeasured HOV/other movements prevent assigning this number to the GP ramp.

additional_assumptions: The 700 and 2000 veh/h additions are explicit constant-flow sensitivity inputs, not observed ramp counts or a calibrated OD estimate.
Only predeclared calibration dates are used; validation dates remain untouched.
